card.name: Digit 1 ending day 31 in dates
card.fires_on: The digit 1 right after a 3 in a calendar date, making the day 31, such as July 31 or December 31. It also fires weakly on the 1 in day 21.

modes.label: Day 31 of a month
modes.description: The final digit 1 in a day-of-month written after a month name.

card.plain: It fires on the last digit of the date 31 after a month name.
